projects.projectName: Premera Blue Cross - Producer Portal Development - Phase 1

riskDescription.context: ALT (23-Oct-2026) reports Premera is planning a big-bang rollout to 2,500+ producers on 22-Oct-2026, with only 11 users validated in end-to-end Edge–DataHub–Producer Portal (OKTA) registration testing.
riskDescription.condition: If issues are encountered during the mass producer onboarding, the rollout may need to be rolled back and remediated.
riskDescription.consequence: Rollback and remediation would disrupt producer onboarding, delay business value realization, damage client trust, and require emergency fixes under time pressure.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Conduct phased validation with pilot user group (50–100 producers) before mass rollout to identify issues early.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Upon detecting critical issues during rollout, halt onboarding, activate rollback procedure, and escalate to project board within 4 hours.
risks.reasoning: ALT (23-Oct-2026) explicitly identifies big-bang rollout risk with limited pre-rollout validation (11 users vs. 2,500+ target); no phased approach or pilot group documented. Target Date: 22-Oct-2026 (rollout date).

riskDescription.context: EMS R857 (Identified, 29-Jun-2026) reports the project has absorbed approximately 14 scope changes (equivalent to 0.75–1 sprint of additional effort) within a fixed-price contract ($650,000), with no formal change orders documented as of 22-Jul-2026.
riskDescription.condition: Further scope additions may exceed the remaining budget or require contract renegotiation.
riskDescription.consequence: Margin could erode, or the client may contest additional charges, leading to commercial disputes and strained relationship.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Implement formal change control process requiring written approval and cost impact assessment for all scope changes.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Should margin erosion exceed 10%, escalate to commercial leadership and negotiate contract amendment or scope reduction with client.
risks.reasoning: Open EMS risk (R857 Identified) corroborated by Project Artifacts (WSR Scope Change Tracker, 22-Jul-2026) showing 14 changes absorbed and 2 Pending; fixed-price contract with no change orders invoked; pattern of scope creep established. End Date: 31-Dec-2026 (EMS).

riskDescription.context: EMS R856 (Resolved) noted performance and NFR issues would only become visible after live Data Hub integration; ALT (23-Oct-2026) reports E2E validation completed with only 11 users before mass rollout to 2,500+ producers.
riskDescription.condition: Performance degradation or data inconsistency may occur under production load (2,500+ concurrent users) that was not visible in small-scale testing.
riskDescription.consequence: Performance issues or data inconsistency in production would require emergency fixes, rollback, or service degradation, damaging client trust and producer experience.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Conduct load testing simulating 2,500+ concurrent users and validate NFRs before production rollout to identify bottlenecks.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Once response time exceeds 3 seconds or error rate exceeds 2%, activate performance tuning team and notify producers of degradation.
risks.reasoning: Carried forward from EMS R856 (Resolved) and re-assessed based on ALT (23-Oct-2026) evidence of limited load validation (11 users) before big-bang rollout; no evidence of NFR validation at production scale in Project Artifacts (WSR 22-Jul-2026) or ALT.

riskDescription.context: Project Artifacts (WSR 22-Jul-2026) report 86 CVEs detected (4 critical, 82 high) in progress and penetration testing not yet started (0% complete); ALT (23-Oct-2026) reports IT validation completed but is silent on CVE resolution or penetration testing completion.
riskDescription.condition: Unresolved critical or high CVEs, or incomplete penetration testing, may remain in the production environment.
riskDescription.consequence: Security vulnerabilities could expose Premera to breaches, compliance violations, regulatory penalties, and reputational damage.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Remediate all critical and high CVEs and complete penetration testing with documented sign-off before production rollout.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Upon discovery of exploited vulnerability, isolate affected systems, apply emergency patch, and notify InfoSec and client within 2 hours.
risks.reasoning: Project Artifacts (WSR 22-Jul-2026) confirm 86 CVEs (4 critical, 82 high) in progress and pen test not started; ALT (23-Oct-2026) silent on resolution; IT validation completed per ALT may indicate acceptable risk level, but no explicit confirmation of CVE remediation or pen test completion.

riskDescription.context: ALT (23-Oct-2026) reports Premera is planning a big-bang rollout to 2,500+ producers on 22-Oct-2026 with only 11 users validated in E2E testing; Project Artifacts (WSR 22-Jul-2026) show 4 weeks of Hypercare planned post-rollout.
riskDescription.condition: The Hypercare support team may be overwhelmed by a high volume of issues, questions, and incidents from the mass rollout.
riskDescription.consequence: High volume of Hypercare incidents could strain the support team, delay issue resolution, and impact producer experience during the critical stabilization period.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Establish 24/7 Hypercare coverage with escalation tiers and daily incident review to ensure rapid issue resolution.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: When incident backlog exceeds 50 open tickets, deploy backup support resources and communicate resolution timeline to affected producers.
risks.reasoning: Combined evidence from ALT (big-bang rollout with limited validation) and Project Artifacts (4-week Hypercare planned); no mention of Hypercare readiness or staffing in ALT. Hypercare period: approximately 22-Oct-2026 to 19-Nov-2026.
